name: Orudoba
source: Belze's subordinate, an old scholar who studies magic and sorcery, and formerly a court magician of a great power. His research, which lacked ethical standards, displeased the king at the time, and he was imprisoned. However, that country was attacked and destroyed by Belze, and Orudoba was freed. Belze decided to place him in the castle, and he did not put any restrictions on his research unless it became bothersome. As a result, Orudoba has come to follow Belze, and is assisting in advancing his army, as well as governing the country. Similarly to his appearance, he cannot wield weapons, and instead uses magic and sorcery.
